title: personal.json quiet_hours
description: The quiet-hour rules of the person, disabled ones included.

weekdays.description: Bit mask of the weekdays, bit 0 = Monday.

end_local.description: Local end time HH:MM; not after the start means the rule crosses midnight.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the rule; absent means the time zone of the person.

enabled.description: Whether the rule is in effect.

version.description: Number of changes of the rule, from 1.
